text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Urara, there you are! ♪ Are you still
fretting
about that wedding?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, everyone! And yeah, I am! Since
she asked
me to plan it, I really want to
make it special...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: But what should I do to make it good?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, would you like to take a break and
spend
some time with us?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
We could go out somewhere if you'd
like. Maybe
you'll be able to find some
inspiration!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Goooooal! Yay! That was an amazing race! Did you see that, Ikuno? Did you see what happened?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness! Urara's smiling again!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It seems watching this race provided her
a
much-needed break. She really loves
races,
doesn't she? ♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The shopping district's really fun too.
There's so
much stuff to browse!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Now that she's had a little breather,
perhaps
something will provide sparks of
inspiration for
her.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Urara, is that you?! When's your
next race?
We'll all make sure to be
there for you, holding
our banners and
cheering you on!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yippee! I love all your support! Your cheers get me really excited before I start running and while I'm running, too!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: I believe our dreams lie up ahead! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wow! We sang that in perfect
harmony! ♪ Talk
about being in sync!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's like our hearts are as one! I'm
so happy!
Ahh, I'm suddenly super
excited!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That was so much fun! Thanks for today,

everyone! I had such a great time!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I agree. It was a very fulfilling day.
Incidentally,
have you had any ideas?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Nnnope! Not a single one! It's a real
thinker, huh?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, what's wrong, Rice? Are you
tired?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry. I wasn't any help.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I invited you out because I saw how hard
you were
trying, and I thought that this
might help you, if
only a little...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
What? But you were a huge help! I
mean...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I was really freaking out before, and now
those
worries are gone!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It was so exciting hanging out with
everyone, and
now I feel like I can really
do my best again!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So you didn't get any ideas, but you got
plenty of
excitement, huh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You know, Urara, I bet the bride asked
you to
help because she felt the same
way.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh? She felt the same way?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Graduate
text_block_list.text:
And you, my little muse, are always
doing your
very best to make things
exciting, and when I
looked at you, I had
a thought.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I see... So that's it! I totally get it now!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I thought I didn't get it, but I actually
knew all
along what I should do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While heading to my office one day, I
bump into
Haru Urara walking along with
a sunny smile on
her face.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I was able to solve my problem!
I'm gonna
make the wedding a
super-exciting one!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You wanna help? Really?! Okay, then
let's look
up exciting races the bride
would like!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, oh! I've gotta ask so many people
for help
too! Hehe. There's so much to
do!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Really? Thanks! Can I get a preview of
your
cheering? Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go for it 'cause I can do it!
Urara, la la
la! ♪ Hehe, here I go!
choice_data_list: 頑張れ頑張れ、ハルウララ～！
